name: email-performance

renderer_definitions.name: email_performance_dashboard
renderer_definitions.description: Read-only email performance dashboard for campaigns and tracked one-off emails.
renderer_definitions.rule: Use `email_performance_dashboard` for read-only email performance across campaigns and tracked one-off messages, with source/provider filters, open and click rates, failed/bounced counts, and detail event timelines.

registry_index.summary: Read-only email performance analytics for campaign and one-off tracked sends.

tool_groups.name: Performance Dashboard
tool_groups.hint: Open unified campaign and one-off email performance analytics.

plugin_rules: The Email Performance plugin is read-only and never sends email.
The dashboard reads campaign analytics through the campaign adapter and one-off analytics from EmailPerformance* records.
One-off personalized sends do not require unsubscribe or suppression handling.
